about_the_game:
EvilTrap

Trapped in a cursed forest under a night that never ends, your only refuge is a fragile wooden cabin.
Demons roam the woods, whispering through the trees, scratching at the walls, trying to force their way inside. If you’re caught outside, they will drag you into the dark.

You must venture into the forest during the same endless night to find firewood, supplies, and any clue that could break the curse. But every time you reach the way out, an unseen force pushes you back, something wants you trapped here forever.

Inside, the cabin isn’t safe for long. Footsteps circle the house. Knocks at the door. A presence peers through the cracks. Hide in closets, under the bed, or melt into the shadows and pray it passes. One demon in particular keeps coming back, learning your habits, testing the locks, waiting for a single mistake.

EvilTrap delivers a short, atmospheric survival horror where the night never gives you a break, and escape is the only hope.

🔑 Features

  • Never-Ending Night – no daylight to save you; manage risk and push deeper into the forest to escape.

  • Psychological & Survival Horror – constant pressure, limited safety, relentless entities.

  • Hide to Survive – closets, beds, and shadows are your lifeline when the demon enters.

  • Atmosphere First – tense audio, oppressive darkness, and a cabin that creaks like it’s alive.
